body:
Hi @chrisvidal, thanks for posting :)

By design, you can't add widgets after the `start` call nor can you remove widgets. Adding this possibility would be a huge change in the architecture of instantsearch.js. We are considering this for the next version of instantsearch.

However, there is a workaround that works pretty well. Add all the possible widgets on the page, and then dynamically hide / show your widgets. Would that work for you?

PS: Feel free to post more details about your application so that we can answer more accurately :)
